source.retrieved_note: 使用维基文库简体转录页。它不是校勘定本。页面叙事里出现「康节先生」，不能据此写成邵雍亲著已被证实。本协议不写邵雍确证亲著。
included: 先天卦数：乾一、兑二、离三、震四、巽五、坎六、艮七、坤八
年月日为上卦，年月日加时为下卦，年月日时总数取动爻
年支子一至亥十二，农历月数、日数、时支子一至亥十二
六除取动爻；一爻动则阴阳互变
excluded: 后天卦数（坎一坤二震三巽四中五乾六兑七艮八离九）
把互卦或象辞改写成结局标签

quotes_from_simplified_transcription.bagua_exact_quote: 如得八数整，即坤卦，更不必除也。
quotes_from_simplified_transcription.line_division_quote: 凡起动爻，以重卦总数除六，以馀数作动爻。如不满六，止用此数为动爻，不必再除。如过六数，则除之一六，不尽再除二六、三六，直至除尽，以馀数作动爻。若一爻动，则看此一爻，是阳爻则变阴爻，阴爻则变阳爻。取爻当以时加之。
quotes_from_simplified_transcription.ymd_hour_quote: 年月日为上卦。年月日加时总数为下卦。又以年月日时总数取爻。如子年一数，丑年二数，直至亥年十二数。月如正月一数，直至十二月，亦作十二数。日数如初一一数，直至三十日，为三十数。
quotes_from_simplified_transcription.worked_example_quote: 辰年五数，十二月十二数，十七日十七数，共三十四数，除四八三十二，馀二，属兑，为上卦，加申时九数，总得四十三数，五八除四十，馀得三数，为离，作下卦。又上下总四十三数，以六除，六七四十二，馀一为动爻，是为泽火革。初爻变咸。

arithmetic.upper_trigram: S = year_branch + lunar_month_number + lunar_day; upper = S mod 8; raw remainder 0 maps to 8
arithmetic.lower_trigram: lower = (S + hour_branch) mod 8; raw remainder 0 maps to 8
arithmetic.moving_line: (S + hour_branch) mod 6; raw remainder 0 maps to 6
arithmetic.line_order: six lines bottom-up, yin 0 yang 1; lower trigram is lines 1-3; upper trigram is lines 4-6; moving line flips that one line

mod8_exact.status: follows the checked sentence 如得八数整，即坤卦

mod6_exact.note: 「爻以六除」写明以六除、用余数作动爻，并写到除尽后以余数作动爻，但没有单独写明余数为零时就是上爻。余数零记为第6爻，是本协议为了让函数在整除时仍有定义而作的边界约定，不是原文引句。

calendar_policy.time_standard: IANA tz database via Python zoneinfo; store the actual UTC offset of each timestamp
calendar_policy.day_boundary: local civil date changes at 00:00; 23:00 still belongs to that civil date
calendar_policy.hour_branch: 23:00-00:59 子1, 01:00-02:59 丑2, then every two hours through 21:00-22:59 亥12
calendar_policy.year_boundary: lunar year and its earthly branch change at Spring Festival (春节), not at 立春 and not at Gregorian 1 January
calendar_policy.leap_month: a leap month uses the same month number as the month it repeats; the leap flag is recorded and is not added into S

library.name: zhdate
library.supported_range: lunar years 1900-2100 as declared by zhdate 0.1
library.verification: Boundary dates used in tests were checked against Hong Kong Observatory Gregorian-Lunar conversion tables, not against zhdate alone.

calendar_policy.note: The time method is a function of the civil timestamp and this calendar policy. It does not take a seed. Repeating it is the same cast, not a new sample.

random_control.encoding: UTF-8 key and domain; counter is uint64 big-endian; each draw uses the first 8 bytes of HMAC-SHA256 as a big-endian integer; rejection sampling below 2^64
random_control.stratum: lunar month number on the scoring set, leap and non-leap together
random_control.preserves: within each lunar month, the multiset of rule probabilities

task.question_template: 在Asia/Shanghai公历日期{date}，请求坐标(31.2304N,121.4737E)所对应的结算网格上，当日降水量合计是否达到或超过1.0毫米？
task.location_note: Public coordinate near People's Square, Shanghai. Not a residential address. The settled series is the grid cell returned in the frozen Open-Meteo snapshot.
information_forbidden: texts written after the prediction time

pilot.role: fit base rate and lunar-month rates only

future_ledger.role: lock predictions; do not fetch or invent outcomes

task.inclusion: every civil date in the window, one event, one subject (the returned grid cell)
task.exclusion: none based on outcome or on the cast
task.missing: a null precipitation value is unresolved: keep the row, do not impute, do not score it
task.invalid_snapshot: if a requested date is absent, or the timezone/unit/offset check fails, the snapshot is rejected rather than repaired

settlement.dispute_policy: no second source and no manual override; later revisions of the API are not applied after the snapshot is frozen

task.stopping: one analysis of this holdout; do not extend the years, change the threshold, or refit the mapping after seeing the score
task.equivalence_test: not pre-registered; a confidence interval that contains zero is not equivalence

probability_mapping.formula: (count of yang lines in the original hexagram + 1) / 8
probability_mapping.status: engineering map fixed before scoring; not a probability stated in 梅花易数

baselines.base_rate: pilot resolved-event mean; if that mean is 0 or 1 use (k+0.5)/(n+1) and record the smoothing
baselines.calendar_only: pilot empirical rate by lunar month number (leap shares the number); month count below 5 falls back to the base rate; 0 or 1 with count at least 5 uses (k+0.5)/(n+1)
baselines.symbol_control: within each holdout lunar month, permute P-MAP-1 probabilities with the frozen HMAC stream
baselines.why_calendar_baseline: 年月日时起卦 under a fixed hour is a calendar function. A gain over the constant base rate can be seasonal information.

study_primary.contrast: mean paired Brier of arm B minus arm A
study_primary.direction: lower Brier is better; a negative difference favors B
study_primary.unit: one prediction per event after aggregating seeds; agent count is not the sample size
study_primary.dependence: cluster bootstrap by ISO week of the Asia/Shanghai date; one subject

statistics.offline_role: execute the engine, public-data path, and scorer on the historical window; not a substitute for the study primary
statistics.bootstrap_p: two-sided recentered bootstrap: share of |bootstrap mean - observed| >= |observed|
statistics.estimand: event-weighted mean of paired Brier differences; clusters are resampled with equal probability and events keep their weight
statistics.residual_dependence: week clusters do not remove correlation between adjacent weeks; intervals can be too narrow

llm_four_arm.what_arm_a_would_be: one JSON probability from the same OpenAI-compatible chat interface MiroFish uses; not the OASIS swarm, not Zep, and not a multi-round MiroFish simulation

arms.A: question, time, and location only, plus a non-informative pad
arms.B: A plus the real cast and structural features, without judgment text
arms.C: same template as B with the within-month permuted cast
arms.D: same keys as B with neutral values

llm_four_arm.aggregation: arithmetic mean across seeds, then one row per event
llm_four_arm.retrieval_note: The prompt forbids tools. That sentence does not erase pretraining memory of public history.
llm_four_arm.equal_budget: identical max_tokens, call counts, and UTF-8 byte length of the user message
llm_four_arm.credential_policy: do not read .env or search for keys; a live run happens only when the operator passes a local config and the named environment variable is set

leakage.historical_replay: outcomes are already public; this run is retrospective engineering evidence
leakage.prospective_lock: future_ledger rows are hashed before settlement and must stay unresolved
leakage.label_access: the cast function rejects an outcome argument; baseline fits see pilot labels only
